input.rights_basis: Pinned primary distributor source-verified declaration with copy/redistribution permission; not a new CC0 license

task.clock: NASDAQ trading session labels; published calendar alias to XNYS
task.target: Population standard deviation of seven unadjusted close log returns ending in the target session; ddof=0; not annualized
task.forecast_information: Only the seven completed OHLCV bars preceding the target session

policy.interpretation: Quoted raw-price volatility includes mechanical corporate-action effects; it is not adjusted economic or total-return volatility

calendar.scope: Session-date coverage against one documented alias implementation, not independent calendars or intraday timestamp certification

evidence.subsequent_review: Separate calendar validation and explicit raw task/policy close D01 file admission before any model performance is consulted
evidence.legacy_technical_report_reference: The source evidence technical_review.json pointer names the preparatory local report; its contents are versioned as technical_snapshot.json in the executed source and quality is embedded in the saved dataset_audit.json

remaining_campaign_gates: common partitions, treatment, budget and full-battery power
final dated protocol and candidate identity before performance evaluation
decision_method: AI-assisted source, calendar and methodological review; not institutional approval or human reproduction
